toegepas.blok: Wat dit aan vriende en gesinne doen
toegepas.voor: Dalk vertel hy sy beste vriend nie meer hoe hy voel nie
toegepas.na: Dalk vertel hy nie meer vir sy beste vriend hoe hy voel nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Spoken Afrikaans marks the listener with 'vir', and 'nie meer' sits more naturally straight after the verb; 'vertel' itself is kept.
toegepas.fout: 'vertel hy sy beste vriend nie meer' drops the 'vir' spoken Afrikaans uses to mark the listener and reads stiff
toegepas.rede_keurder: Natural Afrikaans with the same person, action and listener; protected 'vertel' kept and nothing added or lost.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS: no comma before 'of' when it does not join two clauses, and the study text writes the same phrase without one.
toegepas.fout: comma before 'of' joining two parts of one phrase, not two clauses, and inconsistent with the same phrase in the study text
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation-only fix under AWS that leaves the wording of this lesson-only definition unchanged and matches the study text.

vlae.blok: Wat dit aan vriende en gesinne doen
vlae.teks: In 'n gesin voel 'n kind dalk minder werd as 'n broer of suster.
vlae.rede: Unlike the two examples before it, this sentence never says the child is treated differently because of being a boy or a girl, so a reader may not link it to sexism; fixing it would add content, so it is for the writer.

vlae.blok: Wat dit aan 'n klas of 'n span doen
vlae.teks: 'n Meisie bou dalk nie meer saam nie, en 'n seun sing nie meer nie.
vlae.rede: 'bou saam' is vague without saying what is built (a model, a project), and the sentence does not show that these are the stereotyped activities; clarifying it would mean guessing the intended content.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat dit aan 'n klas of 'n span doen
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Gewoon word' reads awkwardly and is easily confused with 'gewoond'; 'iets gewoons word' says it becomes normal.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Gewoon word' is grammatical and clear, and the proposal repeats 'iets' already used earlier in the same sentence ('verloor iets').

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wat dit aan 'n klas of 'n span doen
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wie die volgende keer uitgelag sal word
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Bare adverbial 'volgende' calques 'who is next'; 'die volgende keer ... sal word' is natural Afrikaans for a future event.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Adverbial 'volgende' is normal Afrikaans and the original reads well; the proposal is longer without being clearly better.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: 'n kind se werk om dit te stop
laat_vaar_vorige.na: 'n kind se werk om dit stop te sit
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Stopsit' is the more natural Afrikaans for putting an end to something ongoing; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Transitive 'stop' (to make something end) is standard Afrikaans and plain for Grade 6, so 'stopsit' is a lateral move in a sentence about who is responsible.

laat_vaar_vorige.na: grootmense om dit stop te sit
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Same verb as the previous sentence so the pair stays parallel.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: Dropped together with change 13, so the pair stays parallel with 'stop'.
